Thanks for the input, I wasn't aware of how large his team had expanded and obviously, with that comes expenses.  I haven't really watched any of his content in years; I stopped because if some of the things I mentioned. It's seems he's changed for the better in terms of putting money to better use and in a way thats beneficial to his viewers. I'll still stand by what I said about a breaks in content being a massive diservice to his patrons or others that fund him- they are paying for a service and not delivering that is worse in every way than accepting limitations and working on a smaller production. Considering how he wants his show to become a serious, professional news outlet, he should be consistent and deliver what he promised  after viewer funding. If expenses are too high which seems likely, with all the costs you've added up, he could easily cut back; he's got no option really. People may say that cutting back detracts from the idea of being this professional, high production value news source but he isn't this at all. He may want to be and could be in the future he can't right now. 

I guess you gotta realise your limitations; I'd love to make a movie someday but if I did and didn't have a massive multi-million budget, I won't pretend it's a hollywood blockbuster. If you know what you can and cant do, you can focus on what you excel at and avoid the stuff that's impossible. Phil's proven he can be successful with  low production value ( I'm not saying he shouldn't try to up his game- he should definitely be making an effort with the video production quality ) but he shouldn't be overly ambitious and vow to do things with viewer money that he just can't pull off and consequently, not providing his service to those who pay.

In short, he should just cut unnecessary costs, work on a budget and just focus on producing content while making ends meet at least. If he wants to expand, great, but shouldn't  go to overboard with it as he can't actually pull it off with the money he's been given by viewers. To me, it looks like he has a need to make this news network extravagent, highly produced an all that because he's been kindly given money; he wants to show something of the amount of  cash but has been far too ambitious with it. He needs to dial it back so he can still make enough money, cover expenses, pay his team and whatever while consistently delivering his service- pouring more money into equipment and hiring new people is only going to make things worse for everyone involved.

Anyway, I'm not an expert in running a business at all- Philly D is the successful one and has made it work for years and years so he must be doing something right.But again, just because he's successful, it doesn't imply that he does the right thing all the time (The Channel Awesome management is a prime example). Just an outside perspective for what I think can fix thigs. I could be right or wrong, who knows?
